recognize_zh: 骨髓切片（H&E）細胞量偏高、造血成分混雜；箭頭標示數顆型態異常的前驅細胞（核仁明顯、核周空亮），雙箭頭指一顆小而單葉核的細胞，疑為小型異常巨核細胞，提示多系發育不良的 MDS。
features: Cellular marrow with mixed trilineage hematopoiesis between fat spaces
Single arrows: cells with round nuclei, open chromatin and distinct nucleoli surrounded by clear cytoplasm, suggestive of atypical/immature precursors
Double arrow: small cell with dense, eccentric non-lobated nucleus and eosinophilic cytoplasm, suggestive of a micromegakaryocyte
Scattered erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and mature granulocytes
No sheets of blasts identified in this field
Limited resolution precludes detailed assessment of individual lineage dysplasia
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section (H&E) shows a cellular marrow with mixed hematopoietic elements between adipocytes. Scattered precursor cells with open chromatin, visible nucleoli and perinuclear clearing are highlighted (single arrows), and a small cell with a dense non-lobated nucleus suggestive of a dysplastic micromegakaryocyte is indicated (double arrow). No sheets or clusters of blasts are evident in this field, although resolution limits evaluation. Findings are suggestive of a myelodysplastic syndrome with multilineage dysplasia in the appropriate clinical and aspirate context; blast enumeration requires aspirate smears and CD34 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.dx: Reactive marrow hyperplasia (e.g., nutritional deficiency, drug effect)
ddx.vs: Reactive or megaloblastic changes lack micromegakaryocytes and resolve with correction of B12/folate or removal of the toxin; clonal cytogenetics favor MDS.
Requires 5-19% marrow blasts or ALIP clusters confirmed by CD34 staining, which is not established in this field.
AML shows sheets of blasts (>=20%) effacing normal hematopoiesis rather than scattered atypical precursors within mixed hematopoiesis.
PMF shows clustered, large megakaryocytes with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei rather than small monolobated micromegakaryocytes.
